scope: Public-source bounded research; no private client letters, broker blotters, complete live risk books or audited individual trade attribution.
selection_warning: Famous successes and major mistakes selected retrospectively. Neither representative sample nor predictive backtest; outcome selection, survivorship, publicity and hindsight biases remain.

evidence_taxonomy.A: Contemporaneous original statement or regulatory/event record; only the factual field it actually documents.
evidence_taxonomy.B: Dated original research now republished, or pre-outcome primary public view after entry.
evidence_taxonomy.C: First-person retrospective account or original text available only through a qualified mirror.
evidence_taxonomy.U: Not established by retrieved public evidence.

crosscheck_grades.compatible: Observed statement and observed position can coexist; does not establish correctness or complete-book consistency.
crosscheck_grades.conflict: Specific factual assertion contradicted by the matched source/time/agency, or explicit admitted departure from a stated plan.
crosscheck_grades.unknown: Insufficient comparable disclosure, mismatched date/mandate/agency or unobserved exposure.

holdings_disclosure.normal_lag: Quarter-end snapshot; normally filed within 45 days, with nonbusiness-day adjustment. Filing time is not trade time.
holdings_disclosure.coverage: Reportable section 13(f) long securities, including qualifying listed options; not all worldwide investments.
missing: Many bonds, private assets and non-US-listed shares
Cash, leverage, funding and portfolio-wide hedges
Purchase prices, actual trading dates and realized P&L
holdings_disclosure.option_guardrail: Reported option underlying shares/value do not disclose premium, strike, expiration or delta. Do not add underlying shares to common shares as stock owned, or turn them into risk weights.
holdings_disclosure.filing_guardrail: Check amendments, confidential-treatment history, form version, units and corporate actions. SEC hosting does not certify accuracy.
holdings_disclosure.current_guardrail: No current full portfolio claimed here. On 2026-10-13, September 30 filings need not yet be public. Any retrieved quarter must retain its report and filing dates.

skill_integration.routing: Choose by instrument, mandate and evidence depth; use separate modules below rather than a universal guru average.
skill_integration.weights: No verified Dalio-native fixed country, asset or master-vote weights. Any weights from the user repository must be labeled implementer heuristics and independently validated.
skill_integration.operationalization: Triggers, required data, invalidation tests and risk gates below are research-design adaptations, not quoted proprietary rules.
skill_integration.abstention: For debt/credit security selection needing issuer covenants, recovery waterfalls, legal enforceability or distressed-credit skill, request a deeply audited specialist or additional research. Macro/debt-cycle expertise does not establish credit-picking expertise.

benchmark_temporal_gate.rule: Freeze both method and security inputs before viewing 2026 outcomes; use publication/filing dates, not period end. Keep DRU-03 and the current COM-13F update in retrospective audit only.
benchmark_temporal_gate.pre2026_disclosure_source: COM-13F-2017 for lag/coverage, not its obsolete value units.
benchmark_temporal_gate.important: A method rebuilt today from pre-2026 materials is a retrospective reconstruction. It is not an actual historical recommendation and still needs prevention of outcome-guided stock/rule selection.
